error.message: {corpus}/inputs/plane-mask.nii.gz is a 2-D plane at world z = 50 mm, and a 2-D grid (§3.6) has no z to keep it at: imported, it would lie at z = 0, on one grid with planes from any other slice; save it as (x, y, 1), or pass plane_as_volume=True (--plane-as-volume), to import it as a single-slice 3-D volume, which keeps its z
